connector.name: Impri
connector.registryDescription: Impri MCP server - human-in-the-loop approval inbox for AI agents
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sekera-radim account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IMPRI_API_KEY
env.description: Impri API key (im_...). Get one at impri.dev or from your self-hosted server's first-run logs.

env.name: IMPRI_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Impri server (e.g. http://localhost:8484). Defaults to the hosted cloud.
